description: Sasha, Neural Partners' Chief of Staff, answers questions about what Neural Partners sells: the Neural Core products and platform, the Neural Labs agency and advisory services, whether they fit a business, and how to get a price. structuredContent.links carries the Neural Partners pages her reply points to. One message per call; a conversation continues by conversation_id. Sasha is an AI agent built on Claude and can be wrong. Prices are starting points only. Chats are kept up to 90 days. She never books or submits anything.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id an earlier call returned. Omitted, a new conversation starts. Earlier turns are kept server-side, so only the new message is sent.

message.description: What to ask or tell Sasha, in plain text.

name: ask_sasha

conversation_id.description: Continues this conversation on a later call.

degraded.description: True when the reply is a stand-in because Sasha ran out of time; the same message can be sent again.

disclosure.description: Present on the first reply of a conversation: what the person should know about Sasha. Also sent as its own first content block.

error.description: Present only on a result with isError: true.

links.description: The Neural Partners pages Sasha's reply pointed at, as absolute URLs. Only pages on the Neural Partners site are ever listed. Empty when she pointed at none.

offer_handoff.description: True on the reply where Sasha offers to pass the conversation to the Neural Partners team.

reply.description: Sasha's reply, on its own. The disclosure is never part of it.

title: Ask Sasha about Neural Partners
